real_return.method: Fisher relation: (1 + nominal) ÷ (1 + inflation) − 1, floored to the basis point

source.section: Reserve Bank of India Act, 1934, section 45ZA, and the Government of India's notification retaining the inflation target and tolerance band for the five-year period 1 April 2026 to 31 March 2031

document.title: Reserve Bank of India, "Monetary Policy -- Overview"

source.note: "In its second review, on March 25, 2026, the Central Government retained the inflation target and the tolerance band for the next 5-year period -- April 1, 2026 to March 31, 2031." A target is a policy objective, not a forecast or a measurement (ADR 0013 [insurance-irr]): a figure the user confirms against it is cited as a statutory target, never as an expected rate of inflation.

inflation.assumption: user-confirmed; a statutory target, not a forecast
